geometry.matching_definition: fluid ALE vertex and solid reference vertex share the same stable node ID and labelled triangle connectivity

kinematics.displacement: solid current position minus shared reference position, m
kinematics.solid_velocity: time derivative of solid displacement, m/s
kinematics.mesh_velocity: solid velocity copied to matching ALE boundary vertices, m/s
kinematics.fluid_wall_velocity: no-slip value interpolated to native P2 boundary nodes; edge midpoint is endpoint average

dynamics.sign: force exerted by fluid on structure; caller converts from sigma_times_fluid_outward_normal by negation
dynamics.nodal_force: current triangle area times constant triangle traction divided equally among its three P1 solid nodes
dynamics.native_fluid_projection: area-average sigma*n_fluid on each current P2/P1 boundary triangle, then negate to traction_on_structure

conservation_gates.discrete_power_identity: sum nodal_force dot nodal_velocity equals sum triangle area times traction dot centroid_interpolated_velocity

strong_coupling_lifecycle.state_machine: shared FsiTrialLifecycle used by existing partitioned coordinator
strong_coupling_lifecycle.fluid_input: exact stamped SurfaceTraction consistent_nodal_force_n is assembled directly into the native tetrahedral solid external-force vector
strong_coupling_lifecycle.solid_output: exact stamped interface displacement and backward-Euler velocity
strong_coupling_lifecycle.finalization: prevalidate numerical and publication owners, then paired noexcept swaps
strong_coupling_lifecycle.coordinator_test: constant-load test fluid plus real native solid converges in two iterations after one reject and unit Aitken relaxation; injected pre-finalize failure preserves committed solid state
strong_coupling_lifecycle.native_end_to_end_invariant_smoke: zero-state closed domain executes harmonic ALE motion, native P2/P1 transient flow, current-configuration fluid traction, consistent solid nodal force, native hyperelastic solid solve, and paired commit

native_nonzero_functional_smoke.case: closed tetrahedral domain with decaying internal P2 velocity pulse loading a supported hyperelastic solid
native_nonzero_functional_smoke.classification: nonzero coupled operator and transaction smoke, not compliant-channel or added-mass validation

native_compliant_channel_functional_smok.case: 20 x 4 x 4 mm channel with parabolic P2 inlet, natural outlet, fixed noninterface walls, and matching supported hyperelastic top wall
native_compliant_channel_functional_smok.classification: idealized five-step functional smoke, not physical, added-mass, spatial, or temporal validation

paired_checkpoint.scope: single-partition native ALE-fluid plus native solid accepted-step state
paired_checkpoint.payload: one deterministic bounded binary payload with fluid, ALE, interface, solid displacement and solid velocity state plus both model/state identities

strong_coupling_lifecycle.native_ale_adapter: NativeTetAleFsiRuntime dense small-case reference; production PETSc adapter remains separate
strong_coupling_lifecycle.legacy_gate_compatibility: new gates default disabled via infinity; native invariant smoke enables finite tolerances

fail_closed: P2 edge absent from fluid topology
deferred: physically calibrated native ALE fluid plus native solid coupled benchmark
